name: workbench
description: The workbench's layout settings: where the activity bar and the side bars sit, and when the secondary side bar shows.

enumDescriptions: A vertical bar beside the primary side bar.
Icons in the primary side bar's header row.
Icons at the bottom of the primary side bar.
No activity bar: the primary side bar shows its current container.
workbench.activityBar.location.description: Where the activity bar, which switches the primary side bar's view containers, is shown.

enumDescriptions: The primary side bar on the left, the secondary side bar on the right.
The primary side bar on the right, the secondary side bar on the left.
workbench.sideBar.location.description: Where the primary side bar (and its activity bar) sits; the secondary side bar takes the other side.

enumDescriptions: New sessions start with the secondary side bar closed.
New sessions start with it open.
New sessions start with it open (it shows only in a session).
workbench.secondarySideBar.defaultVisibi.description: Whether a session without a saved state opens with the secondary side bar (the workspace rail) shown. Collapsing or expanding the rail carries into the next session until this changes.

omnigent.secondarySideBar.autoHideBelow.description: Hides the secondary side bar while the window is narrower than this many pixels (0: never), and shows it again when the window widens.
